title: Verify: Single story-panel class unit tests
summary: Unit tests proving story-panel appears once in the composed layout
description: Add Testing Library tests in the existing layout test file that render GameLayout with StoryPanel and assert class uniqueness and drawer-open placement.
acceptance_criteria: Given GameLayout with StoryPanel, when rendered, then container.querySelectorAll('.story-panel') has length 1
Given the Story button clicked, when open, then the single .story-panel has class drawer-open and .story-content does not
Given StoryPanel alone, when rendered, then the root has story-content and not story-panel
technical_constraints: jsdom environment already declared in the file; no network or server
definition_of_done: New tests pass and fail against the old StoryPanel class

steps.symbol: new: it('Given GameLayout wrapping StoryPanel, when rendered, then exactly one .story-panel exists')
steps.action: Add imports of StoryPanel from '../src/components/StoryPanel' at the top. Inside the describe block add a test rendering <GameLayout scene={<div/>} story={<StoryPanel node={undefined} history={[]} inventory={[]} onChoose={() => {}} />} /> and assert container.querySelectorAll('.story-panel').length toBe 1.
steps.code:
const { container } = render(<GameLayout scene={<div />} story={<StoryPanel node={undefined} history={[]} inventory={[]} onChoose={() => {}} />} />);
expect(container.querySelectorAll('.story-panel')).toHaveLength(1);
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/layout.test.tsx
steps.expected: Test passes with ACT1 applied and fails if StoryPanel root is story-panel.

steps.symbol: new: it('Given the Story button clicked, when open, then only the aside has drawer-open and StoryPanel root is story-content')
steps.action: Render the same composed layout, click the button named 'Story', then assert the single .story-panel element has class drawer-open, that container.querySelector('.story-content') is not null and does not have class story-panel.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/layout.test.tsx
steps.expected: All layout tests pass, including both new ones.
